statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-50528 (GHSA-qvw7-jm5c-6hqw) is a .NET security feature bypass in TLS/SSL (System.Net.Security): an attacker can use the SslStream implementation to bypass authorization checks during secure communication. Microsoft lists the .NET 10.0 runtime packs, including linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64, as affected from 10.0.0 through 10.0.9 and fixed in 10.0.10 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qvw7-jm5c-6hqw, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.10/10.0.10.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold: every build ships the Microsoft.NETCore.App shared framework, which holds System.Net.Security, at its own .NET version, in dotnet10-runtime and in the .NET SDK held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap: 10.0.2 to 10.0.9 in the first eight builds and 10.0.10 or later from 10.0.10-r0 on. The range ends at 10.0.10-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.

Microsoft lists the .NET 9.0 runtime packs, including linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64, as affected from 9.0.0 through 9.0.17 and fixed in 9.0.18 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qvw7-jm5c-6hqw, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/417, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.18/9.0.18.md). DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold. Implementation copies of System.Net.Security.dll are in the Microsoft.NETCore.App shared framework (dotnet9-runtime, and the .NET SDK held by dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap) and in the runtime and NativeAOT compiler packs held by dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap, and each carries the build's own .NET version: 9.0.12 to 9.0.17 in the first six builds and 9.0.18 or later from 9.0.18-r0 on. The other copies are reference assemblies and small .NET Framework and .NET Standard facade assemblies in the SDK's build extensions and in reference packages, with no implementation code. The range ends at 9.0.18-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
